sources.page: E.14.8, Teil E, Seite 38 von 42, PDF p. 38
E.14.7, Teil E, Seite 38 von 42, PDF p. 38
sources.note: Five sighters and ten counted shots in 30 min, or five sighters and fifteen counted shots in 45 min as the organizer announces (E.14.7). The record holds the ten-shot programme.

provenance.note: E.14.8 names SPFG 1 at 100 m and SPFG 2 at 300 m, one shot clause for all classes. E.6.8 and E.14.8 cite the faces as B.10.5.x; Teil B has no such face numbers (B.10.5 is "Eigene Markierungen"), the faces are B.11.1 and B.11.3.
